title: Split PDFs by document ID. Name every file.
description: Turn repeated invoices and statements into named PDFs. Try the browser demo, then process up to 20 PDFs at once offline on Windows.
browserDetail: Preview up to 300 pages. Export PDFs with up to 3 total input pages, or try the built-in 6-page sample.
desktopDetail: Open up to 20 PDFs at once on your own PC (each up to 50 MB and 300 pages). Fillable forms are accepted. Save straight into a new folder or a ZIP, and reuse rules. No internet required after download.
priceNote: One-time purchase for version 1. No subscription. Taxes may be added at checkout. Refund within 14 days of purchase, no questions asked.
pendingDetail: Checkout is not open yet. You can test the free demo now; no payment details are requested.
delivery: After confirmed payment, the checkout provider delivers the download and receipt automatically.
local: Your PDF stays on your device
localDetail: Files and extracted text are processed in your browser. No AI API, document upload or advertising trackers.
exampleDetail: A six-page invoice batch becomes three PDFs: pages 1–2, page 3, and pages 4–6. Their document IDs and customer names become the filenames.
step1: Open your PDFs and draw a box over the document ID.
step2: Choose the text for each filename and check the proposed groups.
step3: Save to a new folder or a ZIP, with a page-to-file manifest.
limitsDetail: Windows with a current Chrome or Edge browser. Static PDFs and fillable forms (field values are fixed into the page as shown). Scans can be split by pages, but there is no OCR or handwriting recognition. Encrypted, digitally signed and dynamic (XFA) PDFs and files with attachments or active content are rejected. Bookmarks and accessibility tags are not guaranteed to be preserved.
languages: 24 interface languages, including right-to-left layouts. Translations are AI-generated and have not had native-speaker review.
demoLimit: The free demo exports files with up to 3 total input pages. Your original is unchanged. Use the built-in sample to test larger groups, or check the Windows version.
freeRelease: Free demo · export up to 3 input pages
faqPurchase: The browser demo is free. The Windows version is a separate one-time purchase. Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase, no questions asked. Your downloaded version does not expire. Future major versions and personalized document setup are not included.
guidesDetail: Step-by-step examples for document IDs, filenames and reusable rules. Guides are currently available in English and Korean.
